Oleshky Evacuees Return to Ukraine After Truce

Evacuees from the Russian-controlled Ukrainian town of Oleshky have returned to Ukraine-held territory following a localized truce. The families were separated for years, with some reporting they "ate grass." The truce, described as the longest of the Ukraine war, ended after 1,711 days, according to one report. Following the truce's end, Russian strikes on Ukraine left thousands without power, and cyber attacks reportedly hit Russia and Ukraine. Some evacuees arrived in Belarus, while others reached Ukraine.
